subject: Celestia AI: Security Q&A and evidence handoff scheduling
messages:
From: Jane Dubois <jane.dubois@celestia.ai>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: security@celestia.ai, procurement@celestia.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + SOC2/SIG Q&A — request to schedule

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this—I'm Jane (Security Lead, Celestia AI). We're working through our vendor intake for Q4 and would like to run a focused 45-minute technical Q&A covering: SOC 2 control coverage, network segmentation, data residency, and your SIG/CAIQ responses.

High-level asks:
- Quick walkthrough of Redwood's SOC 2 scope and any recent changes
- Confirmation of logs/retention (syslog, app logs, audit trails)
- A short network architecture diagram and where customer data is stored
- A table of evidence owners + expected delivery timeline

Are you available for a call this week or early next week? We prefer weekday mornings (PST). If useful, please send any pre-read and an evidence matrix prior to the call.

Also looping in procurement (procurement@celestia.ai) because they may have a couple of contract questions after the Q&A.

Best,
Jane
Jane Dubois
Security Lead, Celestia AI
From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Dubois <jane.dubois@celestia.ai>
Cc: security@celestia.ai, procurement@celestia.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + SOC2/SIG Q&A — request to schedule

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear list. Glad to coordinate.

We can do a 45-minute slot Thu 11/19 10:30–11:15 PST or Mon 11/23 09:00–09:45 PST. Please confirm which works.

Pre-read I can share before the call: a one-page SOC 2 scope summary, a brief CAIQ highlight, and a network diagram. I will also attach an evidence matrix mapping controls to owners.

On our side, Rishi Malhotra (Solutions Engineer) will handle infra/ops controls and Marcus Lin (Security Engineer) will own logging/monitoring evidence. If you want deeper infra-level artifacts we can mark those as post-call deliverables.

Agenda proposal (45 min):
- 5 min: Introductions and scope
- 15 min: SOC2 scope & CAIQ highlights
- 15 min: Logs/retention, network architecture, evidence mapping
- 10 min: Action items + timeline

Attachments I will send after you confirm the meeting slot.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Senior Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 12:07:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Celestia AI: Security Q&A and evidence handoff scheduling

Rishi/Marcus — Jane from Celestia wants a 45-min SOC2/SIG Q&A. I proposed Thu 11/19 10:30 PST or Mon 11/23 09:00 PST.

Can you confirm availability and who will bring which artifacts? Tentative split: Rishi = infra/config (network diagram, VPC peering notes), Marcus = logs/audit (log retention, SIEM screenshots, CSV of retention policies). We'll need a short evidence matrix row for each control we reference.

If you both can take the Thu slot, I'll lock it in. If not, we'll go Mon.

-K
From: Jane Dubois <jane.dubois@celestia.ai>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: security@celestia.ai, procurement@celestia.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Celestia AI: Security Q&A and evidence handoff scheduling

Kimberly — Thu 11/19 10:30 PST works for us. Confirmed attendees: myself, our cloud security engineer (will share a calendar invite), and procurement may drop in for the last 10 minutes.

Please send the pre-read and evidence matrix ahead of the call (even a draft is fine). We will prioritize the log/retention and network diagram sections, and we may ask for copies of the SOC 2 Attestation if available.

Thanks — look forward to it.

Jane
From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Dubois <jane.dubois@celestia.ai>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, procurement@celestia.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call materials: pre-read + evidence matrix (draft)

Jane — thanks again for the call earlier today. Attached are the pre-read pack and the draft evidence matrix as promised. Summary of actions below.

Attachments (delivered):
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 scope summary and attestation date)
- network-architecture-diagram.png (customer data flow & VPC boundaries)
- evidence-matrix.xlsx (controls -> owner -> ETA)

Action items (owner, ETA):
- Marcus Lin: Export of SIEM retention config and sample audit log (ETA 2026-11-24)
- Rishi Malhotra: VPC peering ACL screenshots and router config excerpt (ETA 2026-11-24)
- Kimberly Park: SOC 2 attestation PDF (if permitted) and updated evidence matrix (ETA 2026-11-22)

Notes from the call:
- Celestia requested clarification on our log aggregation pipeline (we committed to a short diagram and a sample retention policy).
- They asked about encryption key management — we provided an overview and noted that details requiring screenshots will be redacted; full KMS configs can be provided under an NDA.
- Procurement requested a brief statement on data residency; we confirmed hosted US regions for their initial deployment and noted options for EU regions on dedicated/private deployments.

If you want these uploaded to a shared Drive, suggest I drop them in the folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/CEL-SEC-QA-2026

Thanks — I'll follow up as attachments are produced.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
